definitions.gloss: literary work; copyrighted work; creative work
definitions.explanation: A work that is the product of creative expression and is protected by copyright law. Includes books, music, art, software, and other original creations.

examples.japanese: この{著作物|ちょさくぶつ}は{無断|むだん}で{使用|しよう}できない。
examples.english: This copyrighted work cannot be used without permission.

examples.japanese: {他人|たにん}の{著作物|ちょさくぶつ}を{引用|いんよう}するときはルールを{守|まも}る{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: When quoting someone else's copyrighted work, you need to follow the rules.

examples.japanese: インターネット{上|じょう}の{著作物|ちょさくぶつ}にも{著作権|ちょさくけん}があるので、{勝手|かって}にコピーしてはいけない。
examples.english: Works on the internet are also copyrighted, so you must not copy them without authorization.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and formal term commonly encountered in copyright notices, terms of service, and intellectual property discussions. The related term {著作権|ちょさくけん} (copyright) refers to the legal right itself, while {著作物|ちょさくぶつ} refers to the work being protected.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著作物|ちょさくぶつ}の{利用|りよう} (use of a copyrighted work)
- {著作物|ちょさくぶつ}を{保護|ほご}する (to protect a copyrighted work)
- {著作物|ちょさくぶつ}の{複製|ふくせい} (reproduction of a copyrighted work)

RELATED WORDS:
- {著作権|ちょさくけん} (copyright — the legal right)
- {著作者|ちょさくしゃ} (author, creator of the work)
